title: An Icechunk store in the browser

dataset.name: A public Icechunk store (ACCESS-NRI virtualized dataset, or a small test store)

left.label: ours (rangefinder)
left.note: No Icechunk reader on our side. rangefinder reads COGs, tiles and plain Zarr; an Icechunk repo is a manifest-and-snapshot layout it does not understand.

right.label: gridlook
right.note: gridlook reads Icechunk stores and groups via icechunk-js (v1.1, v1.3). Right panel URL to be filled once a public CORS-enabled store exists.

gap: Icechunk is a first-class source for gridlook and absent from ours.
bridge: Lift icechunk-js into the shared layer-3 reads module used by rangefinder, so virtual chunk references over NetCDF/COG archives become readable without materialising anything.
todo: ask for or create a small public Icechunk store on a CORS bucket; the ACCESS-NRI virtualization work is the natural candidate
